timeline.summary: Promoter **Ram Agarwal** declared no encumbrance on 42,874,592 shares (72.82%) of Prostarm Info Systems under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
Prostarm Info Systems filed its annual disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of SEBI SAST Regulations confirming zero promoter share encumbrance for FY26.
Prostarm Info Systems submitted the Q4FY26 Monitoring Agency Report showing ₹12.48 Cr unutilised IPO proceeds parked in fixed deposits.
Prostarm Info Systems Limited schedules earnings conference call with analysts/investors on May 25, 2026, at 02:30 PM (IST) to discuss Q4FY26 and FY26 performance.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹104.45 Cr (+27.3% YoY), net profit ₹7.95 Cr (+17.3% YoY).
Prostarm Info Systems reported FY26 revenue of ₹385.8 Cr (+10% YoY) and PAT of ₹33.0 Cr (+14% YoY) with an order book of ₹1,106.4 Cr.
Prostarm Info Systems Limited shared the earnings call recording link for Q4FY26 and FY26 on its website.
Prostarm Info Systems issued a postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval for IPO proceeds variation and ESOP amendments.
Prostarm Info Systems held its Q4 and FY26 earnings call, reporting ₹386 Cr revenue and guiding for 25%+ growth in FY27.
On October 15, 2026, Prostarm allotted 28,98,717 convertible warrants at ₹147 each to 21 Non-Promoter investors, a ₹42.61 Cr preferential issue with 25% (₹10.65 Cr) received upfront.
